_comment: Table for tier.Detect (docs/p2-design.md §3.2, §3.6). Each row applies ops to the fake all-conditions-hold host built by baseline() in fixture_test.go, then compares Detect's tier, Missing (exact, in missingOrder) and, when present, locked/declared. $M=/etc/claude-code, $MS=$M/managed-settings.d/ballast.json, $SELF=/usr/local/libexec/ballast/ballast, $HOME=/home/u (uid 1000); @ORG@ / @MS@ stand for the baseline org.json / managed settings content. Condition 2 note: host lock == condition 4, so env_override only ever appears together with org_config.

rows.name: redirect-vars-ignored-on-locked-host

rows.name: redirect-BALLAST_HOME-on-unlocked-host
